meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by the size of the credit limit, from loans of ₹25,000 or less to loans above ₹100 crore, every quarter since March 2014
meta.note: RBI BSR-1 quarterly (DBIE 947), outstanding credit of scheduled commercial banks excluding RRBs, as at the end of each quarter (dated to that month). Amounts and limits in ₹ lakh crore; accounts in lakh.
